title: Baseline Profiles for Critical User Journeys Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies baseline profiles for critical user journeys?
options: Profile representative critical paths and verify packaged, measured release benefit under controlled compilation.
Expect it to fix blocking I/O
questions.answer: Profile representative critical paths and verify packaged, measured release benefit under controlled compilation.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Baseline Profiles only optimise app startup and cannot improve scrolling or navigation.
questions.explanation: Adding every automated test journey to the profile can bloat compilation and profile maintenance without targeting frequent performance-sensitive paths.

questions.prompt: How do Baseline Profiles differ from Cloud Profiles?
questions.answer: They ship with the release for first-launch benefit, while Cloud Profiles aggregate after real usage and arrive later.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
